messages.text: Heads up all: the 14th floor build-out is done and Technology is moving this weekend. Badge access for 14 goes live Friday 5pm. Monday morning we'll be in the new space.
Trading desk too? Need to know if our monitors and the market data terminals are getting moved or replaced. We can't have a gap during the open Monday.
Desk hardware is being pre-staged by facilities. Terminals get cabled Saturday, and my team will validate OMS and MarketDataFeed connectivity Sunday afternoon before anyone sits down.
Quick question: are the network closets on 14 already patched into the core switches? I want to confirm the VLAN config before Sunday's testing.
Patching finished yesterday. Leo, you own the VLAN validation, so grab the port map from facilities and compare it against our spreadsheet.
Will do. I'll also check that AuthSSO redirects behave from the new subnet so nobody gets locked out Monday.
Separate ask: can the trading seats be laid out in the same order as now? The sales traders sit next to the execution guys for a reason, and moving that around slows us down.
I'll pass that to Linda Brandt's team, since seat plans sit with Operations/facilities. I believe the plan already mirrors the current adjacency, but I'll confirm.
Appreciate it. If it's off I'd rather fix it before the weekend than on Monday at 9:25.
Reminder for engineers: label and bag your own peripherals. Last move we lost two docking stations and a keyboard with a very specific layout.
Ha, yes. Facilities will have labeled bins on 12 starting at 2pm today. Name and desk number on everything please.
Traders: please clear your desk drawers by Friday close. Anything left behind gets boxed and sent to the new floor, and I won't be responsible for what we find.
Update: port map matches the spreadsheet except two drops in the east corner. I flagged those to facilities and they're fixing them this afternoon.
Good catch. Please re-test those two drops once they're done and post the result here, so everyone sees we're on track.
One more thing: is there a backup plan if the Sunday validation turns up an issue with the trading terminals? I'd like a fallback seating on 12 just in case.
Yes, 12 stays fully live through Monday close. If anything fails Sunday, the desk starts Monday on 12 and we move midweek. No risk to the open.
That's what I needed to hear. Thanks, Sam. I'll tell the desk to plan for the move but keep their 12th floor badges active.
Both east corner drops re-tested clean. Link lights, DHCP and AuthSSO login all good from the new subnet. Marking VLAN validation complete.
